name: Someday
source:
Coming out of your shell is hard. It's even harder for Frank, a meek middle-aged divorcee who's recently had a realization that he's not as straight as he once thought. It'll take the enthusiastic encouragement of his younger coworker-turned-friend Ricky for Frank to step out of his comfort zone. But making plans is only half the battle, and sometimes "someday" is further away than it seems.
